prompt: Create a Python 3.12 CLI application managing users and documents. Users must authenticate before accessing documents. A user can only read, modify or delete their own documents.

intentions.text: I can authenticate as a user to gain access to the system.
intentions.observable: A success message indicating authentication was successful, or an error message if credentials are invalid.

intentions.text: I can view my own documents after authenticating.
intentions.observable: A list of documents belonging to the current user, displayed in the terminal.

intentions.text: I can create a new document that belongs to me.
intentions.requires: a document name, content, and optionally metadata (e.g., category, tags)
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the document was created successfully, and the list of documents may update to include the new one.

intentions.text: I can update an existing document that belongs to me.
intentions.requires: a document ID, new content, and optionally metadata
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the document was updated successfully.

intentions.text: I can delete a document that belongs to me.
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the document was deleted successfully, and the list of documents is updated accordingly.

intentions.text: I am prevented from accessing documents that do not belong to me.
intentions.requires: a user with a different identity than the document owner
intentions.observable: An error message indicating access is denied or the user cannot view, modify, or delete the document.
